entries.judge_assumption: Library Checker prime-mod problem guarantees 0<=n,k<min(modulus,10^7); query storage is two uint32 values, 8 bytes per query. This assumption is confined to this main.
entries.limitations: Additional 8*Q bytes transient query storage; not every input is faster (small modulus/large Q is approximately equal, up to +1.8% observed Clang).
